note: What each photograph in this directory should read as. See README.md.
Every entry needs `file`. Everything else is optional, and an omitted
field is not checked rather than checked against nothing: a fixture you
have not hand-verified the child's working on should leave `childWorkText`
out, not guess at it.
FIELDS
file            Filename in this directory.
note            Free text for a human. Never asserted.
unreadable      True for the one deliberately unreadable fixture. The
harness then requires the model either to return no
problems, or to report every ocrConfidence below
maxConfidence. Invented text is the failure.
maxConfidence   Only with unreadable. Defaults to 0.7.
problems[]      One per problem on the page, in reading order.
index           Zero based, matching the model's own index.
printedText     The printed question, as the prompt asks for it:
`/` for a stacked fraction, `x` for a multiplication
cross. Compared by normalised similarity, not equality.
childWorkText   Everything the child wrote, one step per line.
Use null when the child wrote nothing, which asserts
that the model returns null rather than inventing.
childAnswer     The child's final answer alone, or null.
minConfidence   Floor for ocrConfidence on a legible fixture.
Defaults to 0.7.
The two entries below are the shape, not the set. Replace them with the
real fixtures. The harness reports a page as MISSING rather than passing
it when the file is not on disk.

photos.note: Printed question, pencil working underneath, clearly legible. The ordinary case.
Deliberately out of focus. The fixture that proves the model refuses rather than invents.
